verdict.rationale: Homebrew lets a project's repository carry a Brewfile declaring its dependencies, and `brew bundle exec` / `brew bundle sh` can run a shell in a project-specific environment. That activation is a manual command, not automatic on entering a directory. Community users say there is no standard way to install multiple versions of node, Python or php, and some have switched to mise for per-project versions. Missing for 10: automatic activation on directory entry, per-project version pinning, documented setting of project environment variables, independent hands-on corroboration.
